content: Government College of Engineering, Tirunelveli (GCE-TLY) is an Autonomous Institution affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, located in Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu - 627007. Established in 1981, it sits on a 23-hectare campus. Approved by AICTE and DOTE. Offers seven undergraduate and five postgraduate programs. Four UG programmes are NBA accredited: Civil Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, and Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Phone: 0462-2552450, 0462-2552448. Email: principal@gcetly.ac.in.

pageTitle: About Us: Vision, Mission, Quick Facts
content: Vision: to make this institution a centre of learning, research eminence and excellence, fostering innovation and creating future leaders in technology. Mission: provide the best educational facilities for successful careers in a global society; enhance professional competency and analytical thinking; develop socially responsible technocrats with high ethical and professional integrity. Quick facts: 2500+ students, 150+ faculty members, approximately 80% overall placement rate (headline figure; see the PLACEMENTS category for the detailed, department-wise 2025 figures).

The current Principal is Dr. P. Latha, M.E., Ph.D., in office since January 2026 (Present). Immediately prior: Dr. I. Muthumani (October 2025 - December 2025), Dr. S. Sidhardhan (February 2023 - April 2024), Dr. K. Manomani (December 2021 - January 2023), Dr. M. Isaac Solomon Jebamani (January 2018 - May 2019). The founding principal was Prof. Peer Mohamed (August 1981 - June 1982). A full list of every principal back to 1981 is published on the homepage's "Our Legacy of Leadership" section.

Undergraduate (B.E.) admission is via TNEA (Tamil Nadu Engineering Admissions). Eligibility: pass 12th (Higher Secondary) with Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, minimum aggregate marks per government norms (varies by category). Lateral entry is available for Diploma/B.Sc background candidates directly into second year. Process: (1) online TNEA registration, usually May-June, (2) upload 10th and 12th mark sheets plus category/nativity certificates if applicable, (3) merit list published by Anna University/DOTE based on PCM marks, (4) single-window counselling where candidates fill college and branch preferences, (5) report to the allotted college with original documents to confirm admission. Most seats are Government Quota via TNEA single-window counselling.

pageTitle: Admission Process and Guidelines: PG and Part-Time
content: Postgraduate (M.E.) admission is via GATE/TANCET through CEAP (Common Engineering Admission Procedure): online application on the Anna University/CFA portal, discipline-wise merit lists prepared from GATE/TANCET scores, counselling, and single-window seat allotment. Part-Time B.E. (for working professionals) requires a 3-year Diploma in Engineering/Technology from a recognized board plus a minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience after the Diploma, with employment based in Tamil Nadu (proof required). Selection is purely on Diploma aggregate marks -- there is no entrance exam. Required documents include 10th/12th mark sheets, Diploma certificates, transfer/conduct certificates, an employment certificate (2+ years), and an NOC from the employer.

pageTitle: Academic Regulations: Grading System and CGPA
content: GCE-TLY follows Autonomous Choice Based Credit System (CBCS) aligned with Anna University regulations. Letter grades and grade points: O (Outstanding = 10), A+ (Excellent = 9), A (Very Good = 8), B+ (Good = 7), B (Average = 6), C (Satisfactory = 5), RA (Re-appearance / Arrear = 0), SA (Shortage of Attendance = 0), W (Withdrawal). CGPA Formula: Sum of (Course Credits x Grade Points) divided by Sum of Total Credits. Minimum attendance required to appear for end-semester examinations is 75% in each course. Students with 65-74% attendance due to medical reasons or sports representation may be condoned on recommendation by the Principal. Students with <65% attendance (SA) must repeat the course.

Evaluation at GCE-TLY consists of Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA - 40% weightage) and End-Semester Examinations (ESE - 60% weightage) for autonomous batches. Internal assessment is based on 3 periodic assessment tests, assignments, and laboratory evaluations. Revaluation / Photocopy: Students can apply for photocopy of answer scripts and revaluation within 10 days of end-semester result publication. Arrear / Supplementary exams are conducted during regular end-semester examination cycles.
